item.title: [ 31] Bad toast etiquette?
item.description:
So I had a friend come over recently. She asked if she could have some toast, so of course I obliged. I made her two pieces, then as soon as she was finished she asked for two more. Being a gracious host, I of course completed the request, but I thought it was rude as fuck. I would never go to somebody else's house and as for four slices of toast, that's too much. If I was given one slice of toast I might ask for another and that would not feel rude to me, but four slices of toast is taking the fucking piss. Four slices of toast is too high of a percentage of a loaf to take. I wouldn't even make myself four pieces of toast. What I want to know, is my toast etiquette way off, or am I being reasonable? I must stress, I made the toast without complaining, I just felt this rage inside that I'm still thinking about. How much toast is too much toast to request from a host?

item.title: [ 38] Today, a guy who works shift work was bragging to me about making $29 an hour.
item.description:
Today, a guy who works shift work was bragging to me about making $29 an hour. He very proudly and arrogantly claimed that he was middle class.

I told him that $29 an hour isn’t really a middle class income on its own. He then mentioned that his wife also works and I said,”ohh so you need dual income.” I asked how much she made, and he said about $45,000.

I did the math and pointed out that his $29 per hour wage works out to roughly $60,000 a year before tax. Combined with his wife’s income, their household brings in about $105,000 a year before tax. After taxes, their take home pay is probably somewhere around $80,000 a year. (lol)

I told him that, based on those numbers, I wouldn’t consider them middle class. He seemed to think that making $29 an hour automatically put him solidly in the middle class, but when you actually look at the household income and take home pay, it’s a lot more modest than he was making it sound. ($80k a year total household income)

I also mentioned to him studies show every class thinks they are middle class.

Pokémon Champions is a free to play online battle simulator available on Switch with a mobile release later. It features ranked, casual and private battles for both singles and doubles, and will be used for VGC tournaments in 2026.

>/vp/ Champions Tournament
The first of hopefully many /vp/ Champions tournaments will be held soon in early June. All anons are invited to participate in a no-banlist, single elimination, BO3 bracket following standard rules, where the winner will be declared the reigning Champion.
Anons interested in joining are advised to list their time zones to determine the best possible tournament time for everyone involved. Registration will be performed with Challonge.

Quick FAQ
>Do I need my own Pokémon to play?
No, the game features a recruitment system, but transferring from Home is recommended to save time and resources.
>What makes the game so much more accessible than before?
All aspects of a Pokémon are customizable with VP, a currency earned simply by playing the game. IVs are also removed.
Ask in the thread if you want any specific Pokémon, and someone will respond.
>Is there single player content?
No.
>Do I need a Nintendo Online subscription?
No.
>What's the starter pack?
US$6.99 one time purchase for 50 training tickets (fully train for free), 30 Teammate Tickets (recruit Pokemon without using VP), 50 extra box space and the LGPE trainer music.

item.title: [ 49] Murdered Student Henry Nowak Camera Footage Released
item.description:
> Police cam footage: https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=GlDmsdYjbtg

https://www.bbc.com/news/articles/crlpyw05l75o

Student Henry Nowak repeatedly told police officers "I can't breathe" as he lay dying in handcuffs after being stabbed, bodycam footage shows.

The 18-year-old Southampton student was handcuffed after killer Vickrum Digwa, 23, lied to police at the scene of the 2025 stabbing, claiming he had been the victim of a racist attack.

Footage released by the force, with permission from Nowak's family, shows him pleading "I've been stabbed" and an officer replying "I don't think you have mate".

Nowak suffered stab wounds to his legs and a fatal wound to his heart from a 21cm (8in) blade that Digwa said he carried as part of his Sikh faith. He was jailed for life with a minimum 21-year term.

The Independent Office for Police Conduct (IOPC) said an investigation into the police force's actions was ongoing.

Speaking in the House of Commons earlier, Home Secretary Shabana Mahmood revealed a police officer unrelated to the case had been misidentified and forced to relocate in order to protect him and his family.

The attorney general's office is also considering the jail sentence given to Digwa after receiving "multiple requests" to review it under the unduly lenient sentence (ULS) scheme.

Nowak's family, from Chafford Hundred, Essex, called his treatment by police "inhumane and degrading" and the force has apologised.

His father, Mark, said: "Henry told officers that he could not breathe nine times. He told them that he had been stabbed four times. Henry was pulled across the gravel, his hands forced behind his back and he was placed in handcuffs."

He said the contrast between how his son and Digwa had been treated was "unbearable".

"Henry should not have died on the streets of Southampton in police custody," he added.

item.description:
>/g/ makes a 20th album
Theme: Movie score
Title: [Accepting suggestions]
Deadline: Sun. 31st of May, 23:00 UTC
Listening party: Sat. 6th of June, 21:00 UTC

>/g/ makes a 21st album
Theme: [Accepting suggestions]

>How to submit a song for the album
You can upload audio here without a login:
https://catbox.moe/
https://dmpproductions.org/mediaboard/thread/14/
Other services can be used, as long as the download is publicly accessible.

Create a post in /dmp/ with a link to the song.
AI policy:
- "AI" includes all neural network-based models and not hard-coded automation/procedural generation.
- You are allowed to ask an AI about music-related questions, but asking it to give you musical ideas (eg. generating a chord progression) is prohibited.
- AI-generated stems are banned.
- AI-based tools can be applied (eg. stem separation), but in your submission you MUST declare what tools you used and where.
- Every song submission, regardless of AI usage, should include some level of proof that the song was not AI-generated. Typically, this would be a DAW screenshot.
- The album organiser reserves the right to reject a submission if it is deemed that AI was used too heavily.
- If you are unsure about aspects of the AI policy, feel free to ask.

Optionally, you can attach cover art, lyrics, and an artist name to your submission. The artist name cannot be one you use on other platforms.
Songs that break YouTube's rules won't be uploaded there, but will still be added to the album.
By default, tracks will be normalised to -14 LUFS (integrated loudness) in the release. You may specify a lower loudness for your song. Light-touch mastering is sometimes applied to improve the coherence of the album.
